postgres_layer_observation.title: Map layer insert can persist despite UI save failure, then break list hydration
postgres_layer_observation.observed: Normal Add Layer returned the generic save failure. The subsequent normal Layers page threw InvalidCastException converting System.String to Resgrid.Model.MapLayerData while Dapper read the stored JSON data column.
source_findings: MappingService.SaveMapLayerAsync uses the PostgreSQL document repository and sets PgId on insert.
MappingController.NewLayer checks mapLayer.Id.Timestamp, which remains the Mongo-style zero value on this PostgreSQL insert.
MapLayersDocRepository.GetAllMapLayersByDepartmentIdAsync selects the whole data JSON column into QueryAsync<MapLayer> without explicitly deserializing that document.
postgres_layer_observation.restoration: Verified the isolated database, department, six units and three active calls. Backed up only the new exercise-layer row to ignored local storage, then removed that exact name/timestamp/ID match. Normal Layers page loads with zero rows again.
postgres_layer_observation.next_step: Resolve the PostgreSQL save/read path in a separately reviewed product change before rerecording a successful layer creation sequence.
